title: Electrification
purpose: Establish safe IC2 generation, storage, machine processing, and ore doubling.
automation_paths: Ore doubling removes repeated mining; machines accept later automatic inputs.
optimization_opportunities: Keep machines powered, batch compatible work, and avoid needless voltage conversion.
infrastructure_reuse: LV generation, storage, cabling, and processors remain feeder lines for every later factory.

milestones.title: First IC2 Generator
final_validation: Build and fuel an IC2 Generator.

milestones.title: Safe Low-Voltage Network
final_validation: Connect generation, storage, and machines at safe voltage.

milestones.title: Electric Processing Suite
final_validation: Successfully operate a Macerator, Electric Furnace, Extractor, and Compressor.

milestones.title: Demonstrated Ore Doubling
final_validation: Macerate and smelt ore for at least twice the direct-smelting output.

milestones.title: Electric Tools
final_validation: Build and charge basic IC2 electric tools.

milestones.title: Voltage and Safety
final_validation: Explain or demonstrate voltage tiers, transformer placement, and insulation.

milestones.title: Stable Electrical Workshop
final_validation: Operate the full processing suite without cable loss or recurring power collapse.
